content:
Arrange the 14 non-white bulbs:
\[
\frac{14!}{8!6!}=\binom{14}{6}
\]
In a garland, these 14 non-white bulbs create 14 gaps. Choose 12 gaps for the white bulbs:
\[
\binom{14}{12}=\binom{14}{2}=91
\]
Thus the number of arrangements is:
\[
\binom{14}{6}\binom{14}{12}=3003\cdot 91=273273
\]
\[
\boxed{273273}
\]
